Its 2-dose series at least 6 months apart, 3rd-dose logic if dose 2 given early, and optional 0/1-2/6 month accelerated series not encoded.","MenB special situations (asplenia, complement deficiency, complement inhibitor use, minimum age 10): 3-dose series at 0, 1-2, 6 months with interval-dependent dose count (dose 3 not needed if dose 2 at least 6 months after dose 1; 4th dose if dose 3 too early) and same-brand requirement not encoded because dose count depends on intervals; menb_vaccine concept would apply.","Co-administration notes (MenACWY with MenB at different anatomic site) not represented."]}
